title: Distinguishing close-signal warn vs event-send warn is correct
description: The two warn messages — 'SSE client channel full while sending close-signal' and 'SSE client channel full; dropping stalled connection' — are semantically distinct and must stay separate. The close-signal path fires only when batch is empty AND closeafter=state is active (a rare, specific condition). The event-send path fires during normal event delivery. Collapsing them into a single message would make it impossible to distinguish a stalled-during-delivery condition from a stalled-at-stream-close condition when triaging production logs. A future contributor should NOT merge these into a shared helper — the site-specific context is the value.
